p.EVERY-NORMATIVE-STATEMENT-IS-ADDRESSABLE: Every normative statement in this project's spec tree is **addressable**: it lives under a stable `{#kebab-anchor}` and is cited by URI, never by paraphrase.

p.CORRECTION-CITES-THE-VIOLATED-ANCHOR: When the human corrects the agent, the correction cites the violated anchor: "you are violating `spec://…#verification.timeout` — the spec says 600 s, you wrote 300 s".

p.RESOLVE-READ-COMPARE-FIX: Resolve the URI, read the unit, compare, fix.

p.twenty-tokens-exact-hit: Twenty tokens, exact hit — no guessing what "verification" means or which part is "wrong".

p.THE-SAME-CONTRACT-BINDS-THE-AGENT: The same contract binds the agent: when citing the spec — in chat, commit bodies, code markers, review notes — cite the anchor, never a paraphrase and never a line number.

p.EACH-FACT-HAS-EXACTLY-ONE-AUTHORITATIVE-: Each fact has exactly one authoritative anchor.

p.NEVER-COPY-A-NORMATIVE-VALUE-CITE-THE-AN: Never copy a normative value into a second file — cite the anchor instead.

p.two-copies-will-diverge: Two copies *will* diverge, and a later session cannot tell which one binds.

p.CRITICAL-CONSTRAINTS-LIVE-AT-THE-START-O: Critical constraints live at the START or END of a file, never buried mid-document.

p.models-attend-to-the-edges-of-context: Models attend to the edges of context ("Lost in the Middle", Liu et al. 2023/2024); a mid-file invariant is an invariant the reader statistically skipped.

facts.POINTER-THE-SPEC-TREE-LAYOUT: PROP vs FEAT, what goes where, the `.human/` buffer: @spec://org.vibevm.world/addressable-specs/flows/addressable-specs/spec-tree-layout#root

facts.NEVER-CITE-BY-PARAPHRASE-WHEN-AN-ANCHOR-: Never cite a spec section by paraphrase when an anchor exists.
facts.NEVER-DUPLICATE-A-NORMATIVE-VALUE: Never duplicate a normative value into a second file — cite its anchor.
facts.NEVER-BURY-AN-INVARIANT-IN-THE-MIDDLE-OF: Never bury an invariant in the middle of a file.
facts.NEVER-RENAME-OR-DELETE-A-CITED-ANCHOR: Never rename or delete an anchor that has ever been cited — anchors are immutable; retire with a tombstone instead.
facts.NEVER-INVENT-AN-ANCHOR: Never invent an anchor — resolve the URI and read the unit before acting on it.
